title: On Inquiring about the price of coal
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：inquire　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inquire 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the porter ① inquired about the price of coal on the same day, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② inquires about the price of coal before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ inquire about the price of coal at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ inquired about the price of coal before — a line in the journal for August 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Inquiring about the price of coal on the same day, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ inquire into the missing money before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Inquire into the missing money at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ inquires into the missing money on the same day every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ inquired about the price of coal again when nobody else would.

⑩ To inquire about the price of coal, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody inquires about the price of coal before dawn again and somebody must inquire about the price of coal on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 打听（一般过去式 inquired about the price of coal：1993 年挑夫头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 打听（一般现在 inquires about the price of coal：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 打听（不定式 to inquire about the price of coal：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 打听（过去完成时 had inquired about the price of coal：1987 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 打听（动名词 inquiring about the price of coal 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 调查（inquire into the missing money：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去调查追查那笔不知去向的钱）
G. v. 调查（inquire into the missing money：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 打听（后段两处：新来的游客照例 inquires into the missing money，而母亲又一次 inquired about the price of coal）

answers.why: inquire 意为“打听”，1993 年挑夫当天就打听打听煤的价钱，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 inquired。
inquire 意为“打听”，自那以后挑夫天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 inquires。
inquire 意为“打听”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯打听打听煤的价钱”，此处为不定式 to inquire about the price of coal。
inquire 意为“打听”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人打听过，故用过去完成时 had inquired。
inquire 意为“打听”，挑夫说“打听打听煤的价钱这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 inquiring about the price of coal 作主语。
inquire 意为“调查”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去调查追查那笔不知去向的钱”，should ever 之后用原形 inquire into the missing money。
inquire 意为“调查”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻调查追查那笔不知去向的钱（inquire into the missing money at once），以后再也不要提起。
inquire 意为“打听”，新来的游客每个星期都照例调查追查那笔不知去向的钱，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 inquires。
inquire 意为“打听”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就打听打听煤的价钱，用一般过去式 inquired 叙述。
inquire 意为“打听”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要打听打听煤的价钱，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 inquire 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the porter inquired about the price of coal on the same day, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter inquires about the price of coal before dawn whenever the coast asks.
Inquiring about the price of coal on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever inquire into the missing money before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast inquires into the missing money on the same day every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother inquired about the price of coal again, and the coast remembered that half.
